answer: Stop sybils with an orchard jetty: an agent stakes a bond for one orchard row. Each cycle it ships its harvest through a single inlet jetty; verifiers check the jetty manifest, voiding a row whose harvest is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 rows at 17x cost each: each manifest fits one row and one inlet jetty, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents ship once and keep rights.
